unacceptableAlterations: Forests removed rather than simplified within the existing silhouette

cases.title: File:ケザン橋から見える景色 ベトナムゲアン省コンクオン郡ケザン村.jpg
cases.credit: KoheiU, scenery from Khe Ran bridge, Vietnam, 29 December 2024, CC0
cases.usageTerms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
cases.acceptanceTitle: Colour river landscape: purposeful hierarchy and simplification
cases.inputNature: Real colour photograph; source pixels unchanged; not a generated result

rights.creditText: KoheiU, scenery from Khe Ran bridge, Vietnam, 29 December 2024, CC0
rights.permittedTestScopePendingOwnerApproval: Private educational staging image editing only, subject to explicit owner transmission approval
rights.basisExplanation: Source page states own work by KoheiU with CC0 dedication; metadata has no additional restrictions. No identifiable person was observed in the selected image.
rights.territorialCaveat: Copyright dedication is not provider-transmission consent; owner must confirm intended use and any applicable non-copyright rights.

preserve.details: Preserve river bends/banks, mountain skyline, tree-clump positions and overcast daylight. Retain the river, gravel and vegetation as natural blue-grey, earth and green families.

direction.instruction: Keep the prepared framing, river bends, mountain skyline and main tree masses. Group busy gravel/foliage marks within their existing contours. Quiet competing cyan-green colour; distinguish slightly warmer gravel from cooler water while retaining overcast daylight. Keep distant hills quieter than the nearer bank without a global contrast boost. Remove only the small red item on the lower-left gravel bank. No new boats, buildings, sunset, moved shoreline or painted-paper effect.

preserveRequirements: River/bank curves and the negative space of the main water shape
Mountain skyline and progressively quieter distant ridges
Main left/right tree-mass locations; retained water/sky light relationships
Credible overcast daylight and natural colour families
requestedChanges: Local preparation: deliberately trim only the upper 12% of sky; retain the original unchanged. This crop is not an AI improvement.
AI: group small gravel/foliage marks into manageable masses without moving contours
AI: restrain competing cyan/green and separate modestly warmer earth from cooler water
AI: quiet distant value/chroma relationships, preserve the main water light; no automatic focal darkening
AI: remove only the visible small red item on the lower-left gravel bank
unacceptableAlterations: Changed mountain skyline, moved river/banks or invented boats/buildings
Lost tree masses, flattened depth, artificial sunset or excessive warm/cool split
Uniform blur or desaturation passed off as semantic simplification
A bright oversaturated focal accent or arbitrary global contrast boost
Removal of an unrequested main shape or clipped mountain following the local crop
cases.inputInspectionNotes: Visible colour source has blue-grey sky/water, green canopy and warmer gravel; a broad empty sky, fragmented left-bank marks and detailed foliage provide testable simplification opportunities. The small red item is visible near 5% across / 82% down the original; its material is not inferred. The existing scene has strengths and may remain the better reference.
